title: UK police arrest 5 by air base under terrorism act
gist: Reuters brief: UK counter-terrorism police arrested five men near RAF Fairford, an airbase used by the US Air Force, on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act and Explosives Act offences.

themes.theme: Security threat to US-used UK bases

insights.claim: British police arrested five men near RAF Fairford, an airbase used by the US Air Force, on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Signals the Iran war's security risks spilling into Western homelands where US assets are based.

insights.claim: The five suspects were also arrested on suspicion of offences under the Explosives Act, with counter-terrorism officers leading the investigation.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Suggests a potential plot rather than protest activity, raising the threat assessment around allied bases.
insights.quote: The five men were also arrested on suspicion of committing offences under the Explosives Act.
